paths.description: Yahoo Taiwan portal homepage after choosing Reject all; represents search, navigation, weather, finance, feed and advertising surfaces.
Yahoo News index; represents the main news listing template and primary browse journey.
Entertainment section listing; represents a topical section template.
Travel section listing; second content section used to check template consistency and image behavior.
Non-existent route; tests HTTP and no-JavaScript failure behavior.

findings.summary: Animation continues when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The CDP preference probe found one running 1000 ms animation both normally and with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or substantially reduce non-essential animation inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

findings.summary: Route changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML/CSS inspection found no view-transition declarations across the portal and section journeys.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document @view-transition opt-in progressively, with a non-animated fallback.

findings.summary: Initial consent UI fully blocks the page and uses custom dialog markup.
findings.evidence: The first-load screenshot shows a viewport-blocking consent layer before content; DOM inspection reports role=dialog/custom form rather than a native dialog.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep Reject all equally prominent, reduce obstruction where legally possible, and use a correctly managed native dialog or equivalent focus-safe modal.

findings.summary: Advertising and chrome dominate the first useful viewport.
findings.evidence: Homepage screenshot places a 970x250 advertising area above the main news content, alongside a persistent service rail and multiple cards.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer or reduce above-the-fold advertising and prioritize the news/search content in the initial viewport.

findings.summary: Homepage serves a clipped desktop layout on a 360 px viewport.
findings.evidence: At a requested 360x800 mobile viewport, CDP reports innerWidth=1024 and the screenshot shows the right side of the fixed-width portal clipped off.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real responsive layout at narrow widths with intrinsic sizing, reflowed navigation and no minimum desktop canvas.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt to their containers.
findings.evidence: Stylesheet inspection across the rendered homepage found no @container rules; the fixed desktop cards remain wide in the mobile capture.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type and size-aware @container rules for reusable feed, market and weather cards.

findings.summary: Many controls lack visible focus and some targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The focus probe found all 40 sampled Yahoo News controls with computed outline none, and the homepage voice-search control is 28x28 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Use :focus-visible with a strong outline and make touch targets at least 44 CSS px where practical.

findings.summary: Mobile load is slow and main-thread work is heavy.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 5.35 s, TBT 476.5 ms, Speed Index 9.1 s and 4.8 s main-thread work; performance score was 0.54.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, shorten server/document latency, defer non-critical work and split long tasks.

findings.guidanceId: prevent layout shift reserve space CLS aspect-ratio
findings.summary: Most images lack explicit dimensions.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence found 84 of 92 homepage images without both width and height attributes; Lighthouse unsized-images failed, although measured CLS was 0.00007 in this run.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio for every image so space is reserved before bytes arrive.

findings.summary: The page ships a large amount of unused code and blocking resources.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 3,308 KiB transferred, about 1,266 KiB potentially unused JavaScript, 35 KiB unused CSS and 1,720 ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by surface, conditionally load rewards/ads, remove duplicate or legacy bundles, and defer non-critical scripts/styles.

findings.summary: Interactive and image semantics are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 4 unnamed buttons, one image without alt, one unnamed link, two malformed lists and two label/name mismatches.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide accessible names and alt text, repair list semantics and ensure visible labels match accessible names.

findings.summary: Some text does not meet minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast audit failed with two affected node groups.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA in every theme and state.

findings.summary: Heading order and keyboard focus treatment are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse heading-order failed and the CDP focus walk found no visible outline on the first 40 focusable controls on each News template.
findings.suggestedFix: Use sequential headings and a consistent, high-contrast :focus-visible treatment in DOM reading order.

findings.guidanceId: loading empty error success retry undo cancel state
findings.summary: The error route depends on JavaScript to recover.
findings.evidence: A real 404 response contains only a script that redirects to /?err=404; without JavaScript the user gets no useful recovery UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve an HTML error page with a clear explanation, home/search links and retry actions before enhancing it with JavaScript.

findings.summary: Representative pages emit runtime and platform errors.
findings.evidence: CDP Log/Runtime captured 23 entries including document.write failures and an uncaught React hydration error; Lighthouse also reports four deprecated API warnings.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix hydration mismatch and asynchronous document.write usage, then remove deprecated APIs and restore valid source maps.

findings.guidanceId: canonical hreflang http status robots sitemap noindex seo indexing
findings.summary: Homepage omits a canonical URL.
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM probe found an empty canonical value on https://tw.yahoo.com/ while section pages did provide canonicals.
findings.suggestedFix: Add an absolute self-referencing canonical and verify localized hreflang/robots/sitemap consistency.

findings.guidanceId: crawlable links viewport meta robots descriptive link text
findings.summary: A no-JavaScript crawler sees substantially less content.
findings.evidence: Cookie-authenticated raw HTML was 588 KB and not a shell, but only 44.2% of words in the rendered sample were found server-side. Title, h1 and description did survive.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the primary headline/link content and retain real hrefs so crawlers and agents receive the same useful page.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced policy coverage is incomplete.
findings.evidence: The 200 response has HSTS, nosniff, X-Frame-Options and a CSP, but the CSP is limited mainly to frame-ancestors/sandbox and no Permissions-Policy is present; one analytics cookie lacked Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Harden CSP beyond framing, add a least-privilege Permissions-Policy and mark all HTTPS cookies Secure.

findings.summary: A large third-party advertising/analytics footprint remains after Reject all.
findings.evidence: The post-rejection homepage loaded 211 resources, 208 from hosts other than tw.yahoo.com, including Google ads and Taboola; Lighthouse lists a 218 KB Taboola loader and 201 KB Google ad script.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit consent enforcement, remove non-essential third parties after rejection, batch analytics and delay advertising until policy permits.

findings.guidanceId: progressive enhancement graceful degradation no javascript baseline fallback
findings.summary: Core rendered content is not fully available without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Raw/server HTML retained metadata and some content but only 44.2% of the rendered sample words; important feed content is added client-side.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core headlines and navigation, then hydrate enhancements without replacing the baseline content.

findings.guidanceId: http error network failure timeout retry stale data resilient state
findings.summary: The 404 fallback is a JavaScript-only redirect.
findings.evidence: The server returned HTTP 404 with a body consisting of window.location.replace and no usable no-script recovery content.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a complete semantic 404 document with navigation and retry/search options.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes.
findings.evidence: The homepage probe found 7 images over twice their displayed width and 84/92 without dimensions; Lighthouse estimates 158 KiB image-delivery savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive srcset/sizes, modern formats and correctly sized variants, while reserving aspect ratio.

findings.summary: Third-party code is disproportionate to initial user value.
findings.evidence: A 3.3 MiB load includes large Taboola and Google advertising scripts before the core experience has stabilized, contributing to LCP 5.35 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, defer ads/recommendation code and remove integrations that do not justify their byte and CPU cost.

findings.summary: The portal exposes no structured agent capability.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML inspection found no WebMCP or agent-tool registration; Lighthouse agentic-browsing score was 0.5 and its accessibility-tree audit failed.
findings.suggestedFix: For suitable search/news tasks, expose narrowly scoped, permission-aware WebMCP tools while preserving normal forms and links.

findings.summary: DOM-related memory grows after repeated navigation despite stable live DOM.
findings.evidence: After GC and 10 alternating home/news navigations, live DOM count returned from 2325 to 2272 and JS heap fell 0.74 MB, but CDP Nodes rose by 1,988 and listeners by 9. This is a low-confidence retained-node signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile retained nodes/listeners with heap snapshots, identify detached subframes/ad widgets, and clean listeners/observers on navigation.
